confirmation: cd py && uv run pytest tests/test_api.py
summary: Every endpoint that returns events also returns the `seq` it is current as of, and `/stream` takes `after=<seq>`, so a reconnect is exactly "give me what comes after this" with no gap and no duplicate.
title: Make the event seq the only cursor the client tracks

summary: Decisions are MADR 4.0 records, one per file, named `<PREFIX>-NNNN-kebab.md`, with machine-readable front matter; `INDEX.md`, `index.jsonl`, `schema.json` and the Cursor rules are generated from them and never hand-edited.
title: Record architecture decisions as immutable per-file records

summary: Model spend has a hard ceiling per real day, and the simulation's clock speed is whatever that ceiling affords; the unit of cost is the decision point, not the tick.
title: Budget is the independent variable and clock speed is derived from it

summary: Sim time is an integer count of sim-seconds from a seeded epoch, advanced only inside the tick transaction, with a 15-sim-minute scheduler quantum and pacing set by the budget governor.
title: Run on a simulated clock advanced by a discrete-event scheduler

summary: The tick is a barrier: sim time does not advance until every decision due at that tick has a real answer, so a slow model means a slow world and a dead model means a paused world.
title: Slow the clock under backpressure; never default a decision

summary: A recorded run replays to a byte-identical event log from its stored model responses, never by re-querying; every random draw is a pure function of a path (`seed, agent, decision_seq, question`), so no RNG state exists to persist.
title: Replay from the recorded log, and derive every random draw from a path

confirmation: cd py && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy
summary: Python is a single `jeve` distribution whose subpackages are layered (`contracts → world → decide/memory → gen → sim/api`), with an import-layering test as the boundary, and Nx sees three projects: `py`, `web`, `contracts`.
title: One Python distribution with layered subpackages, inside an Nx workspace

summary: Every tick commits its domain mutations, events, decisions, scheduler changes and clock advance in a single transaction; events are append-only and carry a `causes` array of the event ids that led to them.
title: Persist to Postgres with one transaction per tick and a causal event log

summary: An agent is evaluated only at a decision point — task complete, inbox item over an importance floor, schedule boundary, synchronous interaction, or a mandatory timer — and that one request carries every question the role might need.
title: Send one request per decision point carrying the whole decision surface

summary: Tier 1 re-asks only the uncertain questions of a flash LLM through TypeSafe's adapter, which returns the same typed response shape; tier 2 is generative and fires only on an ontology gap or when a viewer needs prose.
title: Escalate on confidence in two tiers, and keep the first tier typed
